_comment: Canonical character names for Parasite (2019). Romanized for English narration. Two families: the poor KIM family and the wealthy PARK family, plus the housekeeper and her husband. Use these exact strings in shots.json chars[]. 'names' is the key the linter reads. NOTE: English recaps commonly use the family-name shorthand (Ki-taek, Ki-woo, etc.); aliases map full/alt forms.

roles.Ki-taek: Kim father (the family patriarch, unemployed driver)
roles.Dong-ik: Park father (wealthy tech CEO, Mr. Park)
roles.Da-song: Park son (young boy obsessed with Native American themes)
roles.Geun-sae: Moon-gwang's husband, hidden in the bunker
roles.Min: Ki-woo's college friend who hands off the tutoring job
